name: Peak Processing Limited
summary: Based in Melbourne, Australia, and founded in 2016, Peak Processing Limited, alongside its subsidiaries, is engaged in the manufacturing, distribution, and sale of recreational cannabis products throughout Canada and the United States. Its extensive product line, available through retail outlets, features items such as beverages, hydrocarbon extracts, various oils, vapes, topicals, powders, infused flowers, and edibles. Furthermore, the company provides a suite of services, including market analysis, product development, production, commercialization strategies, logistical distribution, and product refurbishment. Notably, the firm was previously known as Althea Group Holdings Limited and is slated to officially change its name to Peak Processing Limited in November 2025.
